user.title: Smart AOSU Cloud (experimental)
user.description: First copy your APK and local client profile to /config/smart_aosu_cloud. Unofficial cloud integration. Your password is saved in the Home Assistant config entry.

abort.already_configured: This account has already been configured

inspect_datapoints.name: Inspect device datapoints (experimental)
inspect_datapoints.description: Manually request AOSU IoT datapoint names and types; private values and device IDs are omitted.

init.title: Refresh interval
init.description: One read request for all four devices per refresh. Frequent calls may be rate-limited by AOSU.
